LESSON: ABRAHAMIC COVENANT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: THE BIBLE
Topic 2.2: Abrahamic Covenant

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Abrahamic Covenant
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how to distinguish between Godly from ungodly covenants, Why is Abrahamic covenant important to Christians today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify covenants in modern life and their importance
2. explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify covenants in modern life and their importance

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify covenants in modern life and their importance.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify covenants in modern life and their importance” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify covenants in modern life and their importance” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify covenants in modern life and their importance" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify covenants in modern life and their importance
• Model 2: explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify covenants in modern life and their importance
2. Practise: explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Abrahamic Covenant.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to distinguish between Godly from ungodly covenants, Why is Abrahamic covenant important to Christians today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify covenants in modern life and their importance
• explain the importance of God’s covenant with Abraham

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
